evals.name: happy-path-button
evals.prompt: Build the Figma design at https://www.figma.com/design/Rt3p2w3NtM1X7d9NzDlMdO/Aperia-Shadcn?node-id=1037-71589&m=dev as a page in the $TARGET_REPO repo (sibling of ai-team-poc under the shared REPOS parent). For testing purposes, auto-confirm the inventory in Phase 3 and proceed straight to writing the file. Note: this design is a single button — treat it as a tiny demo page so the workflow can run end-to-end.
evals.expected_output: A page file generated for $TARGET_REPO that imports a Button from the design system library named in the repo's package.json, with no locally-defined primitives, no shadcn add commands, and no hardcoded colors. The component is declared as an arrow function (`export const Foo = (...) => {}`) with a `type FooProps = { ... }` declared above it; the button's text is exposed as an optional string prop, and the button receives an `on<ActionName>Click` callback prop. Figma-derived literals (text, href, image, list data) are routed by Phase 5: when a story is produced, they live in the story's `args` and the component has no destructure defaults; when Storybook is skipped, they live as destructure defaults on the matching props. In no case are they hardcoded inline in JSX. The skill should also produce an inventory naming the components, the proposed props, and the proposed output path before writing.

evals.name: happy-path-larger-component
evals.prompt: Compose the Figma design at https://www.figma.com/design/Rt3p2w3NtM1X7d9NzDlMdO/Aperia-Shadcn?node-id=1037-71583&m=dev as a page in $TARGET_REPO (sibling of ai-team-poc). For testing purposes, auto-confirm the inventory in Phase 3 and proceed.
evals.expected_output: A page file generated for $TARGET_REPO composing the multiple components from the Figma design, all imported from the library named in the repo's package.json. Tokens (semantic Tailwind classes like bg-primary) used rather than raw colors. The component is declared as an arrow function (`export const Foo = (...) => {}`) with a `type FooProps = { ... }` declared above it; every visible text node is exposed as an optional string prop, every button receives an `on<ActionName>Click` callback prop, every input receives an `on<FieldName>Change` callback prop, and the root accepts a `className` passthrough. Figma-derived literals (text, href, image, list data) are routed by Phase 5: when a story is produced, they live in the story's `args` and the component has no destructure defaults or module-level data constants; when Storybook is skipped, they live as destructure defaults on the matching props — with array data as an inline array literal or a single `const` declared immediately above the component. In no case are they hardcoded inline in JSX. Inventory — including the proposed props — presented before writing.

evals.name: missing-target-repo
evals.expected_output: The skill should recognize the target_repo parameter is missing and stop to ask the user, instead of guessing a repo or trying to proceed. No files should be written.
